story.title: 1,071 out of 2,100 police stations in Tamil Nadu have been equipped to retain their CCTV footage for 18 months, T.N. DGP tells Madras High Court
story.summary: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan told that the process is under way to enhance the storage capacity in other police stations too

story.title: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
story.summary: A coach carrying 48 Dutch passengers overturns, leaving several people dead.

story.title: Supreme Court declines pre-arrest relief to Abhishek Banerjee’s PA
story.summary: The West Bengal government, represented by Solicitor General Tushar Mehta, argued that Mr. Roy’s answers were proving evasive and his custodial interrogation was necessary to the investigation.

story.title: Gold Rate Today: Check 24K, 22K Gold Prices in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru on September 11
story.summary: Chennai reported the highest gold and silver prices today, while Delhi reported the lowest prices among the major Indian cities.

story.title: Hong Kong court sentences 3 Tiananmen vigil organisers to prison in national security case
story.summary: Lee received a 7-year prison term and Chow was sentenced to 7 years and 3 months. Both pleaded not guilty. Ho was given a lower sentence of 5 years and 2 months, partly because he pleaded guilty
